_about: Phase 0 fixture (2026-09-15): the 61 distinct wet-room briefs in the stored corpus, hand-labelled. `demand` is the FixtureDemand the parser should extract; `expected` is what wet_room_normalizer must make of it (R1-R5, derived by hand from the labels); `stored` is what the OLD count-based parser actually stored per record — the 'before'.
